notes: Encounters reuse mon_* bodies from creatures/MONSTERS.json. Event names are not new species.
Telegraph must hit board, scout, and sound before the circle arms.
Remembrance items are defined in VENDORS_AND_ITEMS.json. They are spoils, not vendor junk, except where a stall displays a spent token.
Damage still passes HitResolver. boss_rule on the monster row remains the law.
Schedules are hub-hour windows plus a cron-like hint for Aura's board clock. They are not a second calendar.

encounters.name: The Held Curse

telegraph.board: Ward board draws a lowered crest. Offer window tonight.
telegraph.scout: From the fold overlook the hill-body is already there. Crest is the only vertical.
telegraph.sound: A human-like inhale that is not a voice. On the offer, silence.

phases.name: Crest warn
phases.tell: Crest rises like a held blade.
phases.player_response: Break bark plates only to stop the sweep. Do not chase gold in the cracks.

phases.name: Inward breath
phases.tell: Gold leaks and closes. Breath stays inward.
phases.player_response: Stay in the inward cone. Outward breath means someone used the curse.

phases.name: The offer
phases.tell: Crest lowers. Silence.
phases.player_response: Refuse. skill_steel_curse_fold or a Presence refuse. Taking the offer fails the fight with HP still on the bar.

encounters.spawn_anchor: Sundering fold floor, overlook is scout-only

encounters.name: The Fold Basilisk

telegraph.board: Hood-root sketch posted by the ward gate.
telegraph.scout: Overlook shows the hood before the body.
telegraph.sound: Dry scale on stone, then a stop.

phases.name: Hood rise
phases.tell: Hood opens. Windup is not the idle coil.
phases.player_response: Leave the hood-root line or commit to it. Half-measures get the gaze.

phases.name: Stone offer
phases.tell: It wants you still.
phases.player_response: Move on the windup, not after. Killing it is allowed. Becoming a statue is the loss.

encounters.spawn_anchor: Fold floor below the basilisk overlook

encounters.name: The Milepost Fold

telegraph.board: Pinewood Crossing post gains a second card: griffin on the Fantasy side of the seam.
telegraph.scout: The Hub side of the milepost stays clear. The griffin does not perch on the Court road.
telegraph.sound: One pinion beat, then canvas-quiet. Not a horse.

phases.name: Pinion show
phases.tell: Wings make the silhouette. Idle is folded.
phases.player_response: Read the milepost name before you fight. Wrong name fails the scout.

phases.name: Seam test
phases.tell: It tests the gate seam, not the plaza.
phases.player_response: Hold the Fantasy side. Do not kite it through the 42m Court.

schedule.label: Salt-road late day, every fourth day

encounters.spawn_anchor: Fantasy side of the Pinewood Crossing seam. The post itself stays Hub.

encounters.name: The Twelfth Reaper
encounters.mesh_note: No unique mesh. The event dresses an existing harpy as the alpha and jackals as the pack. Do not invent a third body.

telegraph.board: Grove board: a reap is scheduled, theft is not the crime.
telegraph.scout: Harpy above the twelfth edge, jackals on the terrace.

phases.name: Tool theft
phases.tell: They take tools and fruit.
phases.player_response: Recover goods. Downing them here is optional and not the fine.

phases.name: Reap attempt
phases.tell: Alpha goes for a trunk, not a basket.
phases.player_response: Stop the reap. skill_presence_do_not_reap staggers the alpha.

phases.name: Fine
phases.tell: Pack breaks.
phases.player_response: Turn in fruit, not trophies, or the veil standing drops.

encounters.spawn_anchor: Twelfth district edge under the canopy

encounters.name: The Unfinished

telegraph.board: Keeper board draws the ask pose and the mask.
telegraph.sound: A question with no last consonant.

phases.name: Ask
phases.tell: Mask turns. It wants an ending.
phases.player_response: Do not answer with a killing blow yet.

phases.name: Staples
phases.tell: Plates try to close the page.
phases.player_response: Open staples. skill_steel_unburial.

phases.name: Refuse the last line
phases.tell: It offers you the mask.
phases.player_response: Leave the mask. Wearing it completes the page and fails the Refusal of Death.

encounters.spawn_anchor: Unfinished floor under the keeper overlook

encounters.name: The Catalogue That Walks
encounters.mesh_note: Crawler is the body of the event. Wraiths are the margins, not a second boss.

telegraph.board: A catalogue line appears with no author.
telegraph.scout: Crawler between ribs. Wraith bells at the edge.

phases.name: Margin bells
phases.tell: Wraiths circle.
phases.player_response: Catalogue them. Do not finish them.

phases.name: Walker
phases.tell: Crawler advances a line.
phases.player_response: Break the line it is writing. skill_craft_catalogue names what you actually see.

encounters.name: The Census

telegraph.board: Junction slate lights a ring and leaves one number dark.
telegraph.scout: Magenta ring readable at 100m as a single hoop, not a crowd of UI.

phases.name: Ring
phases.tell: Hoop locks the junction.
phases.player_response: Stay unnamed. skill_presence_refuse_count.

phases.name: Missing number
phases.tell: It hunts the dark digit.
phases.player_response: Do not fill it with your name or a friend's.

phases.name: Forced total
phases.tell: It offers a sum that would make you legible.
phases.player_response: Break the sum. A completed census fails the Refusal of Numbers even if you win the bar.

schedule.label: Grid small hours, every third day

encounters.spawn_anchor: Census junction, scout from the cable walk

encounters.name: Junction Null
encounters.mesh_note: Sentinel is the event lead. Construct is the hinge. Drones are ambient, not this roster.

telegraph.board: A junction box ticks a null where a serial should be.
telegraph.scout: Sentinel visor dark. Construct visor bar catches one lamp.
telegraph.sound: Relay click, then nothing in the slot a beep would fill.

phases.name: Serial hunt
phases.tell: Sentinel paints numbers on the ground.
phases.player_response: Step out of your own number.

phases.name: Hinge
phases.tell: Construct tries to close the null.
phases.player_response: Keep the null. skill_steel_pulse on the hinge, not on a bystander.

encounters.spawn_anchor: Live junction box, nest already moved by q_cyber_sparrow_nest if that quest is done

encounters.name: The Outstanding Invoice

telegraph.board: Bell's corner chalks a sum that is not yours until you pick it up.
telegraph.scout: Billhound on the wharf, invoice in the teeth, oil on the chest.
telegraph.sound: Paper snap, then claws on wet wood.

phases.name: Presentment
phases.tell: It drops the invoice at your feet.
phases.player_response: Read it. Denial does not clear the sum.

phases.name: Collection
phases.tell: Pack circles.
phases.player_response: Pay, fight, or witness. Erasing the paper fails the Refusal of Consequence.

phases.name: Stamp
phases.tell: A stamp hovers.
phases.player_response: Take the stamp only after the sum is acknowledged.

encounters.spawn_anchor: Wharf pilings under the gull line

encounters.name: The Last Dome

telegraph.board: Road board: rivet heard. Dome trying to close over the mile.
telegraph.scout: Breaker on the flat, sky still open behind it.
telegraph.sound: Rivet gun rhythm, three then a gap.

phases.name: Raise
phases.tell: A dome rib tries to become shelter.
phases.player_response: Knock the rib down. Shelter that closes the road fails the law.

phases.name: Rivet
phases.tell: It pins the rib.
phases.player_response: skill_steel_dust_kick the pin. Wind does the rest.

phases.name: Open sky
phases.tell: Ribs fall.
phases.player_response: Do not build a replacement roof.

encounters.spawn_anchor: Open flat one mile past the frontier gate

encounters.name: The Road That Followed

telegraph.board: A mile stake is on the wrong side of the rut.
telegraph.scout: Watcher silhouette is a post that moves between blinks.
telegraph.sound: Wood knock, like a milepost settling, twice.

phases.name: Wrong stake
phases.tell: It wears the shape of a legitimate post.
phases.player_response: Read it. If the words are not a road law, it is the watcher.

phases.name: Follow
phases.tell: It paces your wagon.
phases.player_response: Lead the horse. Do not mount. Break the follow by leaving the dome it offers.

encounters.spawn_anchor: Wagon mile between hitching rail and the verge

encounters.name: The Unfinished Sunrise

telegraph.board: Dawn board: perch and hour. Band still on the sentinel.
telegraph.scout: Kite-hover silhouette at 100m, distinct from the aegis kestrel.
telegraph.sound: One chalk-dry wingbeat over the roof.

phases.name: Perch
phases.tell: It offers a finishing blow as help.
phases.player_response: Refuse the help. skill_steel_mercy.

phases.name: Band
phases.tell: The mercy band brightens like a medal.
phases.player_response: Leave the band. Taking the win ends the dawn.

phases.name: Same morning
phases.tell: Sky does not change color to celebrate.
phases.player_response: Walk off the roof. No podium.

schedule.label: Permanent dawn hour, every second day

encounters.spawn_anchor: Spar roof perch, scout from the thermal ledge

encounters.name: The Un-Ender

telegraph.board: Lattice board: gap facing the overlook.
telegraph.scout: The hole in the shape is the read at 100m.
telegraph.sound: A seam pulling shut, then slipping.

phases.name: Gap
phases.tell: It faces you with the missing piece.
phases.player_response: Do not fill the gap with a body.

phases.name: Close attempt
phases.tell: Plates try to finish.
phases.player_response: skill_craft_unend or skill_steel_shard on the seam.

phases.name: Almost ninth
phases.tell: A law offers itself.
phases.player_response: Stop. There is no ninth. Closing the fight as a completed system fails.

encounters.spawn_anchor: Un-Ender gap floor. Overlook is scout-only.

encounters.name: The Compound Mark

telegraph.board: Worker board at the furnace belt: eye and tile skirt.
telegraph.scout: Furnace eye is the only emissive. Skirt is tiles, not cloth.
telegraph.sound: Bellows, then a tile click that compounds.

phases.name: Eye
phases.tell: Furnace eye tracks a debt.
phases.player_response: Name the holder with skill_presence_name_holder. Anonymous damage feeds the mark.

phases.name: Skirt
phases.tell: Tiles add interest.
phases.player_response: Crack one tile. Do not add your own brand.

phases.name: Compound
phases.tell: The sum tries to include the open ledger.
phases.player_response: Keep Esha's ledger out of the circle. Winning by selling the seed library fails.

encounters.spawn_anchor: Furnace belt floor. Overlook is the worker scout.
